description: Authenticate Trellis principals and administer sessions, deployments, exact authority, devices, and login portals.

docs.summary: Rust-owned authentication and authorization administration APIs.
docs.markdown:
# Trellis Auth

Owns browser authentication, participant bootstrap, sessions, exact identity and deployment authority workflows, devices, portals, and connection administration. Bootstrap and browser HTTP schemas remain route-owned.
